title: Why Allah (swt) Sends Floods
body:
Yaa Rabbana, yaa Kareem. Yaa Rabbana, yaa Raheem. Yaa Rabbana, yaa Kareem! As-salaamu `alaykum.
Dastoor, yaa RijaalAllah. Madad yaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and
sits) Yaa `ibaadAllah as-Saaliheen amiduna bi madadikum. Allah, Allah. SubhaanAllah. Say, a`oodhu
billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! Yaa Rabbana yaa rabbighfir warham
anta khayru rahimeen.
••• ••••• •••• •••• •••••• ••••• •••••••• •••••• •• •••••••••
Shahru Ramadan awwalahu rahmat wa awsatahu maghfira wa akhirahu itqan min an-neeraan. The first (ten
days) of the month is mercy, the second (ten days) is forgiveness, and the last (ten days) is salvation from the
Fire.
O our Attenders! We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) If we are standing up a thousand times for Allah Almighty's
respect, it is always nothing, nothing, nothing! Don't be lazy ones! Believers who believe must always be
powerful. Those who are asking power from eating and drinking, their levels are on the levels of animals,
because animals are taking power from eating and drinking. Therefore, their owners are always keeping a
sack with barley or a few have wheat. Wheat is for Mankind and barley is for donkeys. But now people are

very anxious, because they are looking that when donkeys eat barley they are getting too strong. Therefore,
they are saying, "What must we do? We can't eat barley." Then people think they are going to eating barley
and Shaytan is saying, "Make beer, a drink from barley, and when you drink it you will become strong like
donkeys."
First of all, German people are making beer. Irish people are saying, "No, we are drinking whiskey." Russian
people are saying, "We are making our famous drink from potatoes."
From potatoes? Yes. Who remains? The very famous drinkers, French people, are saying, "We are not using
such things, we must make our drinks from grapes, as it has been said in holy books about grape vines. But
the most powerful one is barley. We tried everything, but we are not finding anything like powers of barley,
because when we are drinking beer we may shout like cocks! Yes, then we are becoming very powerful.
Therefore, we must use it because our teacher, our dearest friend, Shaytan, is teaching us to making drinks
from barley to make us sound like donkeys."
And people everywhere are drunk now! Everywhere they are drinking, and the Lord of Heavens prohibited,
"Don't drink such drinks that alter your minds and make you like donkeys, shouting like wolves, attacking
like foxes, making trips and traps, and so many kinds of wild animals! Mankind has been granted an honor!”
Allah Almighty just created every Creation on this world and then He sent Sayyidina Adam (a) and his wife to
be king (and queen) on this world. Allah Almighty is not making for Mankind a final preventing not to come
to Paradise, but saying, "You did something wrong, go down and be clean. When you are going to be clean, I
am taking you in Paradise, because you did something that made you dirty and dirtiness can't be in Paradise.
You disobeyed, you ate dirtiness, and therefore, Paradise is not a place of disobedient people, so get out! Be
clean and then come. Until you are going to be clean, it is forbidden for you to enter Paradise."
That is all prophets' declaration and message, "O People! In the end, your Lord is not making you not to come
to Paradise, but He is ordering, 'You must be clean, then you may come in.'" In this life if you are not
cleaning, maybe in your graveyard you will be clean, or on the Day of Resurrection, and if not, finally you will
be taken to hells and cleaned. And then the entrance of Paradise is opening for you, but the entrance of
Paradise will never be opened for dirty ones; they must be kicked out! That is the heavenly message that

124,000 prophets brought to people, "Come back and be clean, because Paradise can't have dirty ones."
Therefore, can you enter mosques and you are not clean? You are coming to mosques and the Lord of
Heavens is ordering His angels, "Look at My servants who are attending, coming to Me, and asking to be
clean ones. Make them clean and bring them to My paradises!"
O People! From east to west, it may be they are hearing or not. O our Attenders from east to west, from north
to south! The first command of the Lord of Heavens, the first condition is, "Be clean and come!" If you are
not getting clean, impossible. Even if you are living in this life and you are not going to be clean ones, you will
also be kicked out from this world and from the community. Communities are teaching, if you are coming to
their gatherings, "Go, dirty ones. Come clean and you can be with us. If you are not clean, you can't be with
us." And that is a sign for believers. Believers must be clean!
What was the Seal of Prophets (s) teaching all prophets? Our Prophet taught all prophets; no one can be
taught by the Lord of Heavens except the Seal of Prophets! Allah Almighty taught him, and the Seal of
Prophets (s) was teaching all prophets. Allah Almighty was saying to His most glorified and chosen one in His
Divinely Presence, "O My honored one! Say to all prophets that they may say to their nations to be clean, and
say, ••••••• •• ••••••• An-nadhaafatu min al-imaan, 'Cleanliness is from (basics) of faith.’”
Cleanliness is the pillar our beliefs stand on. If no cleanliness, no imaan! Dirty ones are never entering to
Paradise. Cleanliness has a wide meaning. Everything you are using must be clean and this body is a grant
from Allah Almighty to you, and you must use it clean! If you are not using it clean, then you will be treated
by some kinds of means to make you clean. Not clean, not welcome. Clean ones are welcome, dirty ones are
thrown away.
And we are now in a holy month, Ramadan Mubarak, blessed month among the twelve months that Allah
Almighty is making a means for His servants to be cleaned with inner cleanliness. It is okay that we must use
clean clothes, but really we have been asked to be clean in our physical being and beyond that we must try to
be with a clean heart, because Shaytan is always asking to enter the hearts of people and leaves its dirtiness
there. If Shaytan leaves its dirtiness in the heart of a person, that one will be similar to Shaytan, or at least
they will be agents of Shaytan. And Shaytan and its agents are going to be taken by angels to the same place.

O People! Muslims throughout east and west, keep the orders of Allah Almighty and try to be clean ones. This
holy month, Ramadan, makes people clean and when you are going to be clean, then you are going to be free
from shaytanic desires. As long as you have shaytanic desires in your heart, that is never going to be clean.
Fasting is helping us to be clean! And fasting according to the levels of people gives benefit to Mankind.
O People! Come and fast! And fasting is not only for Muslims in our days, before Islam in Judaism there was
the same cleanliness and they had fasting. And also for Christians, they have also been ordered to be clean
ones, and they have different kinds of cleanliness. If they are not using those orders to make themselves
clean, it is forbidden for them to come in Paradise! They are never going to be welcome by angels, saying,
"Get away, dirty one! O Angel of the Fire, take those dirty ones until they are going to be clean and then bring
them." There will be a special entrance. Paradise has eight entrances for believers to enter, and those who are
keeping heavenly advices and the ways of prophets are going to enter from eight doors. Those who are not
clean and have been sent to the Fire, when they are getting out as clean ones, there is a special private
entrance and their Paradise is never going to be similar or the same as for the nation of Sayyidina
Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
O People! That is a general message from the Heavens from all prophets, to call people to be clean, nothing
else! Look now, those who are living on this planet, which of them are going to be accepted as clean if they are
not using heavenly ways or heavenly methods or heavenly teachings that are making them clean? Look in the
east and west, they are not using. If they are not using, there are some other means to make them clean. And
all troubles now on Earth are from heavenly punishment and cursing. Floods are not from Allah Almighty's
mercy, but it is a cursing! If Allah Almighty is blessing, He is sending His Mercy Oceans to people to be so
happy and so beautiful! But those floods and fires are not blessings, they are cursing, because people are so
disobedient to their Lord. And more and more cursing may come if they are not coming back to obedience.
Every evil and devil is running from east to west, from north to south, including in the Islamic world also.
Therefore, they may look at heavier cursing coming and this is a chance for all Muslim nations first of all, to
take care of the holy commands of Allah Almighty, to try to be clean in this month, or a heavy cursing is
coming, and they will be taken away! As we have been informed through heavenly knowledge, from five, four
are going to be cursed and taken away, and only one from five will be on Earth.

O Mankind! Think on it from east to west! I am a weak servant, and they are ordering me and giving some
heavenly knowledge and support for addressing all people. If you are accepting, it is for you. If you are not
accepting, it is a cursing for you also. May Allah forgive us.
Fatihah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah,Sultaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Fatihah.
(Baya`)
